inference_rules.reason: Amazon Nova keeps a conservative lower bound of 128,000 context and 5,000 output from the Nova product documentation; exact per-model limits remain the Bedrock model card's authority.
Claude 3 is the pre-reasoning generation: 200,000-token window, 8,192 max output, image input, no reasoning capability, and legacy lifecycle.

The Claude 4 generation is documented with a 200,000-token standard window, 64,000 max output, image input, and tool use; extended thinking has no documented nameable effort ladder in the pinned sources.
The Claude 5 generation (Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5.1, Mythos 5) is documented with a 1,000,000-token window, 128,000 max output, image input, tool use, and low..max adaptive effort.
ERNIE 5.1 is observed as a text-only non-reasoning record with a 128,000-token window and 65,536 max output.
ERNIE 5.x is observed with a 128,000-token window, 65,536 max output, and multimodal input.
The Doubao Seed 2.x line is observed with a 256,000-token window and 128,000 max output; thinking is a toggle.
The literal id `default` is a client alias, not a model: no text-routing capabilities or limits apply.

The Codex auto-review mode is an internal reviewer agent, not a selectable model; the repository has no dedicated reviewer-agent protocol, so text-model routing does not apply and no static limits are published.
Spark's reviewed current executable definition carries 128,000 context / 8,192 output and the xhigh reasoning profile; the Codex subscription listing exposes it as a real-time coding model.
Command A Plus is observed with a 128,000-token window, 64,000 max output, and multimodal input.
Command A Reasoning is observed with a 256,000-token window and 32,000 max output.
Command A Vision is observed with a 128,000-token window and 8,000 max output; it exposes no tool calling.
The original Command A is observed with a 256,000-token window and 8,000 max output.
Cohere North Mini Code is observed with a 256,000-token window and 64,000 max output.
The earlier DeepSeek V3/R1 line is text-only with a 131,072-token window and 8,192 max output.
DeepSeek V3.2 is a superseded text-only generation with a 163,840-token window and 65,536 max output.
DeepSeek V4 Flash is documented with a 1,000,000+/384,000 surface and accepts image input; thinking is a toggle rather than a named ladder.
The V4 generation shares the documented 1,048,576 context and 384,000 max output surface with a thinking toggle.
DeepSeek V4 Pro is documented with 1,048,576 context and 384,000 max output, text-only input, and a thinking toggle.

No family-specific official model card matched this provider-scoped id. Applied the conservative project default for an unclassified text response model: tools and streaming supported, vision and reasoning unsupported, smallest documented family-free limits (131,072/8,192), lifecycle active unless observed otherwise.
